images.prompt:
EDIT IMAGE 1 by outpainting only its flat mid-grey placeholder. Deliver one 1536x1024 PNG, same framing and size. IMAGE 1 is the edit canvas: its LEFT 256 columns (x=0 through 255), including both painted forest and pure green, are LOCKED existing neighbour pixels: preserve them exactly unchanged. Fill x=256 through 1535 with seamless continuation; no vertical join at x=256. IMAGE 2 is reference for painted style and forest story ONLY, never its composition, sky, architecture or mountains.
Asset: upper-middle panel of a 3x2 continuous parallax CHARRED FOREST VALLEY background, panels overlap by 256 pixels. Continue the supplied far ridge of tiny burnt treetops naturally to the right from its existing height near y=375-400, with gently undulating forested valley terrain. Above the tree/ridge silhouette EVERYTHING is perfectly flat pure #00ff00 RGB(0,255,0), matching the existing green exactly, without gradients, clouds, sky, smoke or other marks in the keyed region. This is an isolated forest layer; forest fills every pixel below its silhouette down to the bottom edge. Extend the existing grey-purple ash ground, dense black skeletal trunks and branches, scattered orange glowing embers and small lingering fires, curls of grey smoke confined below the silhouette, and winding river reflecting orange sunset. Continue any river channels and terrain contours reaching the strip boundary organically across the new painting. Trunks become larger, denser and darker toward the bottom. No foreground cliff rim or ledge; no architecture or ruins; no characters, creatures, text, UI, borders, watermark or vignette.
Style: hand-drawn painted 2D like a modern hand-animated action game frame, confident hand-drawn dark contours with visible taper and varied weight, lighter thinner contours in the distance, clean painted material planes inside the lines, restrained texture and readable small silhouettes, no conspicuous grain. Rich environmental detail, graphic shapes and jewel tones consistent with references. Deep cool low-value blue/violet/ash ambient, readable dark shadows, fixed upper-left key; warm orange localized fire and reflective river accents with local light spill. Preserve the left strip, its scale, perspective, palette and all existing pixels. Replace all grey placeholder, smoothly matching the neighbour without changing it. Solid pure green above treetops is essential.

concerns: Visual inspection found no visible join or prohibited content. Exact left-strip pixel preservation and pure #00ff00 values were not measured.
